detail: Full summary: This machine's twining server for EVERY session is this repo's dist/ via the /opt/homebrew npm-link symlink (the launcher's npx rung resolves twining-mcp@^2.0.0 to the global install). dist/ sat stale at Jul 24 while package.json claimed 2.6.0 — sessions ran pre-2.6.0 assemble (relates_to resolutions ignored, NL-parser fabrications present) for 11 days. dist rebuilt 2026-08-04; run npm run build after any server change or pull, and restart sessions to load it. The currently-running session server still has the old code in memory — the retired 07-24 warning will stop surfacing from the NEXT session onward.
